title: A SOLEMN OATH AND A SPREADING FAME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the Lord is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates." So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land. — Josh 6:26-27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua closes the account with a solemn oath: whoever tries to rebuild Jericho will do so at terrible cost. This was a permanent marker of God's judgment, a warning not to undo what God had decreed. Centuries later, in the days of King Ahab, a man named Hiel did rebuild Jericho and lost his sons exactly as Joshua had foretold (1 Kings 16:34). God's word, even His words of warning, always proves true. What He says, stands.

Then comes the closing summary of the whole chapter: "So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land." Notice where the emphasis falls. Joshua's fame spread — but only because the Lord was with him. His success was never his own achievement; it was the fruit of God's presence. Strip away God's presence, and Joshua is just a man walking around a wall.

This is the great secret behind everything in this chapter. Jericho did not fall because of Joshua's brilliance or Israel's strength. It fell because "the Lord was with" His people. God's presence is the true source of all lasting fruitfulness.

The same is true for us. Jesus said, "apart from me you can do nothing" (John 15:5). Whatever good we accomplish flows from His presence with us and in us. May our aim never be our own fame, but that the Lord would be with us — and that whatever comes of our lives would point people not to us, but to Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you credit your successes to your own strength, or to God's presence with you?
2. How seriously do you take God's word, including His warnings?
3. Is your deepest desire your own fame, or that God would be with you and glorified?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, remind me that apart from You I can do nothing. Be with me in all I do, and let my life point people not to myself, but to You. Amen.
